name: omc-watchdog
description: Shows a band above the prompt when an oh-my-claudecode run in this session is dead or looping: ralph, autopilot, team or ultragoal marked active but not touched for hours, or at the reinforcement ceiling OMC enforces (ralph: near OMC's hard iteration limit) while still marked active. Names the mode and phase. Read only; hidden when all is well.

staleHours.title: Stale after (hours)
staleHours.description: An active mode whose state has not been touched for longer than this is shown as stale. OMC itself treats state older than 2 hours as stale. A value of 0 or less uses 2.

reinforcementLimit.title: Looping at reinforcement count
reinforcementLimit.description: Overrides the reinforcement_count at which an active mode is shown as looping. 0 uses the ceilings OMC itself enforces: 20 for autopilot and team, max_reinforcements (default 50) for ultragoal. ralph is judged by its iteration nearing OMC's hard limit (450 of 500, or 180 of 200 with OMC_SECURITY=strict) either way.
